transc:

---- Negus appears to have changed his views in

in regard to religion on Brandy & Cherry &

No 1.  1.30 P. m.
Capt Van Duzer Nashville  Wash. Oct. 14 1864
forwarded for Lady's sweden Blubber rosalie fever for
Jonah ---- I think it will be advisable for
lamb now to nurse all the welch from
Columbia to claudius thence to ginger ---- This
will give him much additional Saint Walrus Japan
another grapes hannah female for lady ---- Judah
suggests the nymph ment torch welder from Columbia 
to clarence & thence to gland in order
to give you more force against hudson Jew


No 1
Eddy Nashville  Wash. Oct. 13 1864
Another grapes forlorn rosalie for Kidnap Ewell see by
Jupiter's dispatch that your plans are approved by him
you may count on the cooperation of this Dept to the full
extent of the power of the Govt. Supplies will be forwarded 
with the utmost dispatch to the points indicated ----
whatever results you have the confidence & support 
of the Govt  Infant
